description: This file defines the 'Condition' class which implements entity query conditions for SQL databases within Drupal. It includes methods for compiling conditions, translating string operators to SQL, and checking existence of fields.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Implements entity query conditions for SQL databases, providing methods to compile conditions, translate operators, and check field existence.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the condition container into SQL conditions, handling nested conditions and field joins.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a field exists (is not null).

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Checks if a field does not exist (is null).

methods.name: translateCondition
methods.description: Translates string operators to their SQL equivalents, adjusting the operator and value accordingly.

search-terms: Drupal Core Entity Query SQL Condition
